description: This file defines function declarations for file I/O operations used in the touchstone project, specifically for extracting hostname information from configuration or marker files and saving hostname data to a marker file.

methods.name: extractHostnameFromCommConf
methods.description: Parses a 'communication.conf' file to extract the hostname, returning a dynamically allocated string that callers must free.

methods.name: extractHostnameFromMarker
methods.description: Reads the '/tmp/server.txt' file and returns its contents as a string.

methods.name: saveHostnameToMarker
methods.description: Creates or overwrites the '/tmp/server.txt' file with the specified hostname string.
